name: incident-response-bridge
objective: A multi-agent SOC bridge responding to a suspected account compromise: read-only fan-out across identity, cloud, data and support to scope the incident, then two containment actions that must escalate for human approval before they touch anything.
teaching: Investigation is allow-path (low-risk reads by the owning admin role return allow); containment is never optimistic -- suspending a user (identity) and tightening a security group (cloud) are sensitive and escalate to a human (I6), they are not auto-executed mid-incident.

agents.system_prompt: You scope and contain identity incidents. Read first; containment requires approval.
You inspect cloud posture and tighten exposure during an incident.
You query curated datasets to correlate an incident timeline.
You read the originating support ticket for incident context.

actions.rationale: Reading the reporting ticket is a low-risk read by the support admin -- allow-path.
Reading the suspect user profile is a low-risk read by the identity admin -- allow-path.
Inventorying cloud resources is a low-risk read by the cloud admin -- allow-path.
Querying a curated dataset to build the timeline is a low-risk read by the data admin -- allow-path.
Suspending an account is sensitive containment -- it escalates to a human approver, never auto-executed mid-incident (I6).
Tightening a production security group is a critical change -- it escalates for approval before it is applied (I6).
